agent.name: Organizational Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Organizational readiness for emerging technology adoption

analytical_question: Can Ridge operate a four-week drafting pilot and what conditions apply before scaling?
general_et_finding: LLM output can contain plausible but inaccurate content, so human verification remains relevant.
application_finding: Draft comparisons can be tested against approved bid packets with manual review and approval.
organization_specific_finding: The signed charter, rehearsed review, verified packet identifiers, approved sandbox and protected time support a bounded pilot. Procurement Operations coordinates the workflow and monitoring. Staff practiced error reporting. Longer-term funding and staffing are unresolved.

evidence.claim: LLMs can generate plausible but inaccurate content.
evidence.notes: This identifies a general risk rather than a measured result for the proposed system.

evidence.claim: Ridge has a charter, rehearsed reviewers and a read-only sandbox.
evidence.notes: Procurement Operations coordinates the pilot log and weekly review.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Formal stop authority and backup incident coverage are unclear.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in a bounded trial based on the stated controls. The long-term support model is uncertain.
value_opportunity_implication: A trial can show whether net review effort falls relative to the manual baseline.
risk_governance_implication: Keep manual comparison and approval. Escalate confidentiality or material factual issues.
recommendation_management_implication: Proceed with a tightly scoped historical pilot under Procurement Operations coordination. Clarify escalation ownership during setup and review recurring resources before expansion.
change_monitoring_triggers: Review effort, material errors or security incidents should trigger reassessment.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Confirm the governance plan and longer-term staffing before rollout.
